summary_en: Nippon Seiki will acquire up to 3.61 million shares (6.27% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥9.979 billion through an off-hours block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on September 18, 2026, at the September 17 closing price of ¥2,764 per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchases of Treasury Stock through Off-hours Block Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 17, 2026, Nippon Seiki's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock through an off-hours block trade (ToSTNeT-3) executed on September 18, 2026. The company will purchase up to 3.61 million shares (6.27% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total consideration of ¥9.979 billion. The purchase will be executed at the block trade session on September 18 at the September 17 closing price of ¥2,764 per share.

The acquisition is undertaken to pursue flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions and to enhance shareholder returns through improved capital efficiency. The company notes that the actual number of shares acquired may be zero or partial, depending on market conditions. Results of the purchase will be announced following the completion of trading on September 18, 2026.
